item.title: How Vaccines Train Your Immune System (Without Making You Sick)
item.description: Vaccines don't fight disease directly — they teach your immune system to recognize a threat before it ever shows up. Here's the mechanism, step by step.

item.title: How Antibodies Work
item.description: Antibodies are specialized proteins produced by B cells that neutralize foreign invaders.
